Tax is computed to the exact cent with round-half-up, so float dollars are risky (binary rounding error on products like 12.5 * 8.25%). Proposal: money as integer cents at every module boundary (1250 = $12.50); percentages as percent numbers (8.25 = 8.25%, matching rates.csv); lookups that find nothing raise KeyError. If the team keeps float dollars, I will convert to cents internally in tax.py, but then the rounding rule must be stated in the decision: tax is rounded half-up to the cent after multiplication in Decimal.
